name.description: add: the new connector's name; update/delete/test: an existing one, exact

base_url.description: add (required): scheme and host, e.g. https://api.example.com. update: replaces it

refs.description: update: a present-and-empty field clears it (no credential/proxy, or Forward picks a Collector); an absent field leaves it alone

extra_headers.description: non-secret HTTP headers; authenticate with refs.credential_id, not a header

endpoints.description: add (required, non-empty) or update (replaces the whole list): static endpoints only, pagination is not settable here
